summary: AzureStorageSettings — unified settings for Azure Blob Storage and Azure Files. Discriminated by SERVICE_TYPE: Literal['blob','files']. ACCOUNT_URL is auto-derived from ACCOUNT_NAME + ENDPOINT_SUFFIX via ParameterSpec.template. Accepts AzureADAuth for AAD authentication.
lifecycle_notes: Consolidated from two legacy classes (AzureBlobStorageAuthSettings, AzureFilesStorageAuthSettings) in Phase 4
documentation_hooks: SERVICE_TYPE='blob' for Azure Blob; SERVICE_TYPE='files' for Azure Files — same class, different SDK under the hood
